_comment: Prose guard budgets — ASD-STE100 mechanical subset (see scripts/check-prose.ts). Tracked files are grandfathered at their commit-time violation count and may not grow beyond it. Clean prose + lower the numbers over time; the ratchet only goes down. New files not listed in `budgets` must be at or below `threshold`.
_excluded: docs/http-api.md is generated by gen:docs. docs/CHANGELOG-archive.md is frozen history. CHANGELOG.md is partly drafted by version-bump. CLAUDE.md is a symlink to AGENTS.md (warren-b771) and shares its budget. AGENTS.md-adjacent skill files and .agents/.factory/.claude prose are agent instructions, not user-facing docs — a later phase.
